summary:
Backend and software engineer with eight years in production. I am Tech Lead on SAWIS BI: I own the PHP application and the MySQL data path (import/export jobs, recovery when a job fails). I do not own SAWIS servers or pipelines. I own Indawo end to end for the app and guest OS: spec, cost, plan, ship. I coordinate a PM, a senior, and a mid on that book. Contract title at Silicon Overdrive is Software Developer.

Cloud is real and bounded: I use existing AWS (EC2, RDS, Lambda, IAM), hold AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, and I manage Indawo's Azure guest OS — not the cloud account. I like hard problems and I am easy to work with. I am targeting Senior and Lead backend roles internationally, and I am building toward Staff without pretending I am there yet.

Kubernetes: two years of homelab k3s/k3d (stand up, break, fix). No EKS/GKE/AKS at work.
Cross-team influence: I lead delivery on the clients I own, not the company platform org.

experience.title: Software Developer — Tech Lead, SAWIS BI · client owner, Indawo
bullets: Tech Lead on SAWIS BI: own the PHP application and MySQL import/export path for the wine industry. When a job fails I diagnose the data path and recover it. I do not own SAWIS servers, pipelines, or cloud accounts.

Own Indawo as the client engineer: sit with the client, spec and cost new work, set the plan, then develop and review with the team until they sign off. I coordinate a project manager, a senior developer, and a mid developer (not line manager). I keep delivery and invoicing on track.

Indawo production incident: on-prem CentOS hardware died. I containerised the legacy PHP app with Docker onto spare hardware, fixed publishing/networking, and restored the site. The app now runs on an Azure VM; I manage the guest OS and application, not Azure infrastructure.
Indawo delivery path I own: pull requests, automated post-deploy health window (~10 minutes). 24/7 ownership if the site is down while the server is up — not a paid on-call rota.

AWS in paid work: EC2, Lambda, RDS, IAM on accounts that already exist. CodePipeline and SonarQube. AWS DevOps Engineer Professional earned in this role. I am not the company platform team or account architect.
